name: Context Lookup
description: Registers `context_lookup` for on-demand topic/section retrieval, plus optional trigger-based section routing and privacy-safe observe-only write telemetry.

topicsFile.description: Path to the topic registry JSON file, relative to workspace root (or absolute). Defaults to 'topics.json'.

toolName.description: Override the registered tool name. Defaults to 'context_lookup'.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes returned per lookup. Files larger than this are truncated with a note. Defaults to 64000.

skipAgents.description: Agent IDs to skip — the tool will not be registered for these agents.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to workspace root. Only needed if the host does not supply one via api.runtime.workspaceRoot or api.getWorkspaceRoot(). Falls back to ~/.openclaw/workspace (honors OPENCLAW_PROFILE) as last resort.

enabled.description: Enable deterministic prompt-trigger routing and write telemetry. Defaults to false.

observeOnly.description: When true, record write-without-route events without blocking. When false, block recognized new destinations until context is loaded. Defaults to true.

telemetryFile.description: Optional JSONL telemetry path, relative to workspace root or absolute. Records no prompt text or full destination path.

maxInjectedBytes.description: Maximum bytes injected from a matched topic's default section. Defaults to 2500.
